material.locator: Eurostat, Review and implementation of the degree of urbanisation — 2026 edition, §1.2 (printed p. 6) and §2.1 (printed p. 7).
material.description: §1.2 notes that national urban/rural definitions differ; §2.1 states that the harmonised method complements rather than replaces national definitions. This supports a statistical-comparison boundary, not a claim that the method supersedes national legal or administrative definitions.
